text:
nina.design: quick copy check — empty state in the 'Routes' table currently says: 'No routes yet. Add one to get started.' a11y flagged the CTA 'Add one' as ambiguous out of context.

harry.pm: agreed. product wants the CTA to explain what happens (create route to route requests to a model). keep it short.

devon.eng: implementation note: link opens the create-route modal. we can add aria-describedby to the empty state paragraph.

zoe.a11y: link text should be meaningful when read alone. options: 'Create a route', 'Add a route', 'Get started: create route'. Prefer 'Create a route' for clarity. Also ensure the empty state paragraph has id referenced by aria-describedby if we want extra context for screen reader users.

nina.design: microcopy candidates:
- Short: 'Create a route' (button)
- Contextual: 'Create a route to send requests to a model' (visually heavier)
I'll update the empty state with the short CTA plus a 1-line helper that will be aria-describedby="#routes-empty".

harry.pm: product ok with that. also add title attribute on the button with the longer description for hover.

devon.eng: i'll wire up aria-describedby to the hidden paragraph and ensure focus order focuses the modal when the button is activated.

zoe.a11y: checklist: meaningful link text, aria-describedby present, empty-state announced regionally (role="region" aria-live="polite"), sufficient contrast for CTA.

nina.design: thanks — i'll push the figma change and a PR with the copy tokens. will post links once ready.
